stories.headline: COP31 SPILLS INTO OVERTIME AS FOSSIL-FUEL LINE VANISHES
stories.summary: Nearly 200 nations haggle past Friday's deadline in Antalya; the draft deal drops all mention of fossil fuels and a finance target.

stories.headline: 148 DRONES, 3 MISSILES: KYIV HIT AGAIN OVERNIGHT
stories.summary: Russia's overnight raid kills a boy of 7 and a paramedic in Kryvyi Rih; 117 drones downed, water cut in five Kyiv districts.

stories.headline: TWO RUSSIAN MISSILES LAND IN POLAND
stories.summary: Kh-101 cruise missiles and a jet drone come down near the Ukrainian border; Warsaw calls it a deliberate provocation.

stories.headline: THREE MISSILES DOWNED OVER RIYADH
stories.summary: Saudi-led coalition intercepts three Houthi ballistic missiles aimed at the capital, days after the PIF tower was struck.

stories.headline: M6.7 QUAKE SHAKES THE ANDES, FELT IN LIMA
stories.summary: Deep tremor 34 km north of Junin at 108 km depth rattles the capital; homes damaged, power out, no deaths reported.

stories.headline: BEPICOLOMBO ENTERS ORBIT AROUND MERCURY
stories.summary: After an eight-year voyage, ESA and JAXA's twin orbiters are captured by the innermost planet; science begins in April.

stories.headline: WORLD COURT: MYANMAR GUILTY OF ROHINGYA GENOCIDE
stories.summary: The International Court of Justice finds a state guilty of genocide for the first time; Myanmar calls the ruling unfair.

stories.headline: TRUMP, XI AND PUTIN SIGN SHENZHEN PEACE DECLARATION
stories.summary: The first trilateral summit of the three leaders ends with a four-point declaration that says nothing about Ukraine.

stories.headline: 700,000 FLEE AS ETHNIC CLASHES SPREAD IN THE SOUTH
stories.summary: Fighting over Moyale between Oromo and Somali communities displaces nearly 700,000; 50,000 cross into Kenya.

stories.headline: JET LANDS SAFELY AT DAVAO AFTER ENGINE FIRE ALARM
stories.summary: Air Niugini flight PX19 diverts with 137 passengers and 9 crew; all evacuate by slide, airport closed for two hours.

stories.headline: BLACK FRIDAY ON WALL STREET: S&P -3.7%, BTC $58,810
stories.summary: AI sell-off drags the S&P into correction, Nvidia falls 14% in a day; Bitcoin slides 4% as fear hits extreme.

stories.headline: ANTONELLI FASTEST IN VEGAS — VERSTAPPEN TAKES POLE
stories.summary: The new world champion's 1:33.893 tops qualifying, but a five-place grid penalty hands pole to Verstappen.

stories.headline: ANTHROPIC DEBUTS AT ABOUT $2 TRILLION
stories.summary: The AI lab's stock market debut is the biggest IPO in history, valuing the company near $2 trillion.
